mapper.select:
SELECT id, task_id, record_type, subrecord_type, source_text, target_text, target_lang, source_text_hash, created_at, updated_at FROM translation_cache WHERE target_lang = #{targetLang} AND (record_type, subrecord_type, source_text_hash) IN
(#{item.recordType}, #{item.subrecordType}, #{item.sourceTextHash})
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO translation_cache (task_id, record_type, subrecord_type, source_text, source_text_hash, target_text, target_lang, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.recordType}, #{item.subrecordType}, #{item.sourceText}, #{item.sourceTextHash}, #{item.targetText}, #{item.targetLang}, NOW(), NOW())
ON CONFLICT (record_type, subrecord_type, source_text_hash, target_lang) DO UPDATE SET target_text = EXCLUDED.target_text, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, task_id = EXCLUDED.task_id, updated_at = NOW()
